profile.visual_desc: Human knight in blue spiked plate armor and a flowing red cape. Rides a grey armored steed with a dark blue mane. Rear-isometric view.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Determined male face with tanned skin, wild reddish hair, and a blue headband. Intense expression facing left.
profile.weapon_desc: Long silver polearm held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Standing idle facing up-left. Polearm is held horizontally across the mount.
profile.step2_windup: Rider lifts the polearm vertically with both hands, preparing a heavy downward strike.
profile.step3_impact: Horse rears up while the rider thrusts the polearm down. A large, V-shaped golden light beam erupts from the impact point.
profile.step4_finish: Horse lands as the rider stabilizes. The golden energy dissipation effect fades while returning to a neutral pose.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The V-shaped golden energy beam in Frame 4 correctly originates from the polearm tip and extends upward along the strike path.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation follows reference logic; weapon handling and VFX timing are consistent with requirements.
